findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_investors_us" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Fuzzy-search investors by name; resolves to CIKs ordered by AUM Case-insensitive partial-name match against the latest-holdings view. Returns the largest funds …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
